title: The Zebrafish Reference Genome: GRCz11
description: The Zebrafish reference genome (Danio rerio, assembly GRCz11) spans approximately 1.37 Gb across 25 chromosomes, encoding approx 26,200 protein-coding genes (estimate). This record is the assembly-level overview: the anchor for the deterministic scale chromosome -> gene -> protein product -> pathway -> trait used across this database. REFERENCE GENOME ONLY: a public consensus assembly, never any real person's private genetic data. In the Signature framework this locus is read as a deterministic instruction in the organism's living program: address, operation, and output are fixed by the reference assembly, and every Signature reading stays anchored to the public reference fact.
how_it_works: Genome assembly stitches long sequencing reads into chromosome-scale scaffolds, annotates genes by homology and experiment, and publishes the consensus coordinates everyone references. All records in this database hang off these coordinates deterministically. In the Signature framework this locus is read as a deterministic instruction in the organism's living program: address, operation, and output are fixed by the reference assembly, and every Signature reading stays anchored to the public reference fact.
key_points: Assembly GRCz11: the public reference coordinates.
Size approximately 1.37 Gb; 25.
Gene content: approx 26,200 protein-coding genes (estimate).
standards: Coordinates follow the named assembly GRCz11
Numeric values are approximate unless stated; estimates are labeled
